item.title: The Malliaris–Shelah theorem p=t
item.statement: In ZFC, the pseudointersection number p equals the tower number t.

references.title: Shelah, A Comment on p < t

item.strategy: The required proof assumes p<t, forces with ([ω]^ω,⊇*), forms the generic ultrapower of H(ℵ1), and constructs a cofinality-spectrum problem. Its no-cuts-below-treetops theorem and Shelah’s peculiar-cut existence under p<t yield contradictory cut conclusions (Malliaris–Shelah §§2–9,14; Shelah Theorem 1.12). These substantial theorems must be proved as earlier local dependencies before this theorem can be ready.
